questions.stem: A 22-Year-old primigravida with 32 weeks of gestation presents a history of pedal edema, increased generalised weakness, and frequent headaches. Her previous usg and lab reports are normal. She is on iron and calcium tablets. On examination, her P- 89/min, BP-156/98mmHg, RR-12/min, saturation normal, afebrile, pallor+, B/L pedal edema+. Abdominal examination shows uterus in-between umbilicus and xiphisternum, vertical lie, breech presentation, FHR-140/min. Her BP was examined again after 10mins and was 148/96mmHg.
